In line along each line as seen from the south, the nearest in front, each further one spread sideways (750 kV 12 m, 330 kV 10 m) and fainter so all can be seen: a drawing; in line they would hide each other. True sizes relative to each other (one scale, flat view).
The bases at 12.8 m under the old water (no. 19's, the only published depth) and the bed (inferred, about 8.4 m under the old water at the 750 kV caissons) drawn at one level for every tower.
No coordinates, numbers or states of individual towers; no damage or repairs shown.
